paper.title: Variance-Dependent Regret Bounds for Non-stationary Linear Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Non-stationary linear contextual bandit with known variance
unmapped: Noise is bounded |eps_k|<=R a.s., conditionally zero mean with heteroscedastic conditional variance sigma_k^2
Per-round variance sigma_k is revealed to the learner together with the reward
Total variance sum_k sigma_k^2 <= V_K (known upper bound)
theta_k chosen by an oblivious adversary subject to variation budget B_K
settings.definition_quote: the environment generates an arbitrary arm set $\cD_k \subseteq \RR^d$ ... reveals the stochastic reward $r_k = \la \btheta_k, \ab_k \ra + \epsilon_k$ ... $\PP(|\epsilon_k| \le R) = 1, \EE[\epsilon_k | \ab_{1:k}, \epsilon_{1:k - 1}] = 0, \EE[\epsilon_k^2 | ...] = \sigma_k^2$. For the case with known variance, we assume that at each round $k$, the variance $\sigma_k$ is also revealed ... $\sum_{k=1}^{K-1}\|\btheta_{k+1}-\btheta_k\|_2\leq B_K$ ... $\sum_{k=1}^K \sigma_k^2\leq V_K$.

settings.name_in_paper: Unknown per-round variance, known V_K and B_K
unmapped: Noise bounded |eps_k|<=R, conditionally zero mean with unknown heteroscedastic variance sigma_k^2
Total variance bound V_K and variation budget B_K known (used for tuning)
settings.definition_quote: whereas in the unknown variance case, the $\sigma_k$ can not be observed.

settings.name_in_paper: Unknown per-round variance, unknown V_K and B_K
unmapped: Noise bounded |eps_k|<=R (R known), conditionally zero mean with unknown heteroscedastic variance
V_K and B_K unknown to the learner
settings.definition_quote: To deal with the more general case where $V_K$ and $B_K$ are unknown, we can employ the \emph{Bandits-over-Bandits} (BOB) mechanism

symbols.Lambda_T: upper bound V_K on total variance sum_k sigma_k^2

conditions: <a, theta_k> in [-1,1] for all a in D_k
tuning: confidence radius beta_hat_k as in Eq. (defbanditbeta)

source.label: thm: regret for algo1 final
source.quote: Let $0<\delta<1$. Suppose that for all $k \geq 1$ and all $\ab \in \cD_k$, $\la \ab, \btheta_k\ra \in [-1, 1]$, $\|\btheta^*\|_2 \leq \pnorm$, $\|\ab\|_2 \leq A$. With probability at least $1-\delta$, the regret of Restarted-$\algbandit$ is bounded by \frac{2A^2B_Kw^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\alpha}\sqrt{\frac{d}{\lambda}}+ 4\hat\beta\sqrt{V_K + K\alpha^2}\sqrt{\frac{Kd\iota}{w}}+ \frac{4d\iota K\hat\beta\gamma^2}{w}+\frac{4d\iota K}{w}

results.notes: K mapped to T, B_K to V_T, V_K to Lambda_T, A to L_feat. Remark 3 notes Õ(d sqrt(V_K)+d) in the stationary case B_K=0 with w=K, alpha=1/sqrt(K).

symbols.Lambda_T: upper bound V_K on total variance

conditions: A, lambda, B, R treated as constants

source.label: thm: regret for algo1 final
source.quote: Specifically, by treating $A,\lambda, B, R$ as constants and setting $\gamma^2 = R/\sqrt{d}$, we have \text{Regret}(K) = \tilde O(B_Kw^{3/2}d^{1/2}\alpha^{-1}+ dK\alpha/\sqrt{w} + d\sqrt{K V_K/w} + dK/w).

symbols.Lambda_T: upper bound V_K on total variance

conditions: A, lambda, B, R treated as constants
tuning: w = d^{1/4} sqrt(V_K/B_K) if d V_K^6 >= K^4 B_K^2, else w = d^{1/6}(K/B_K)^{1/3}

source.label: corollary for algo1 regret
source.quote: Assume that $B_K, V_K \in [\Omega(1), O(K)]$. Then by selecting w=d^{1/4}\sqrt{V_K/B_K}, dV_K^6\geq K^4B_K^2, w=d^{1/6}(K/B_K)^{1/3} otherwise. and $\alpha = d^{-1/4}B_K^{1/2}wK^{-1/2}$, the final regret is in the order \text{Regret}(K) =\tilde O(d^{7/8}(B_KV_K)^{1/4}\sqrt{K} + d^{5/6}B_K^{1/3}K^{2/3}).

results.notes: Holds with high probability as derived from Theorem 2.

symbols.R_noise: almost-sure bound R on the noise
symbols.Lambda_T: upper bound V_K on total variance

tuning: confidence radii beta_{k,l} as in Eq. (def:beta)

source.label: thm:regret1
source.quote: Let $0<\delta<1$. Suppose that for all $k \geq 1$ and all $\ab \in \cD_k$, $\la \ab, \btheta_k\ra \in [-1, 1]$, $\|\btheta^*\|_2 \leq \pnorm$, $\|\ab\|_2 \leq A$. ... then the cumulative regret of Algorithm~\ref{alg:1} is bounded as follows with probability at least $1 - 3\delta$: \text{Regret}(K)= \tilde{O}(\frac{A^2\sqrt{d}w^{\frac{3}{2}}B_K}{\alpha}+(w\alpha^2+d)\sqrt{\frac{K}{w}V_K}+(1+R)(K\alpha^2+\frac{Kd}{w}))

results.notes: Probability 1-3delta. Theorem also gives simplified form with A,R constants: Õ(sqrt(d)w^1.5 B_K/alpha + alpha^2(K+sqrt(wKV_K)) + d sqrt(KV_K/w) + dK/w). Remark 9: Õ(d sqrt(V_K)+d) when B_K=0.

symbols.Lambda_T: upper bound V_K on total variance

source.label: corollary w alpha opt
source.quote: Assume that $B_K, V_K \in [\Omega(1), O(K)]$, then by selecting w=d^{1/3}(K/B_K)^{1/3}, K^2\geq V_K^3d/B_K, w=d^{2/5}(KV_K)^{1/5}/B_K^{2/5} otherwise. and $\alpha = d^{1/6}\sqrt{w}B_K^{1/3}/(K^{1/3} + (V_KKw)^{1/6})$, we have \text{Regret}(K) = \tilde O(d^{4/5}V_K^{2/5}B_K^{1/5}K^{2/5} + d^{2/3}B_K^{1/3}K^{2/3}).

symbols.Lambda_T: upper bound V_K on total variance (unknown to learner)

tuning: Exp3 meta-learner over candidate pool P of (w, alpha) pairs as in Eqs. (bob pool),(w set),(alpha set)

source.label: theorem bob
source.quote: By using the BOB framework with Exp3 as the meta-algorithm and Restarted $\text{SAVE}^+$ as the base algorithm, with the candidate pool $\mathcal{P}$ ... and $H=\lceil d^{\frac{2}{5}}K^{\frac{2}{5}}\rceil$, then the regret of Restarted $\text{SAVE}^+$-BOB (Algo.\ref{alg:bob algo}) satisfies \text{Regret}(K) = \tilde O(d^{4/5}V_K^{2/5}B_K^{1/5}K^{2/5} + d^{2/3}B_K^{1/3}K^{2/3}+d^{2/5}K^{7/10}).

results.notes: Theorem states d^{2/5}K^{7/10} but abstract/table/proof give d^{1/5}K^{7/10}; recorded as in theorem. Probability type not stated in theorem; proof bounds the meta-learner term in expectation and the base term via high-probability Theorem 8, so marked expectation with low confidence.
